museum: Musée des Confluences
classification_basis: Peer-reviewed description (synchrotron study of a complete mummy with bandages, balms, stomach contents); no image checked
provenance: Kom Ombo (Kom-Ombo); presumably el-Shatb necropolis, Lortet excavations February 1909 (Porcier et al. 2019)
acquisition: Lortet/Gaillard-era collection (1897-1909) - general statement, not object-specific
date_period: Roman period; 14C 1935 ± 30 BP, 1-130 cal. AD (Porcier et al. 2019, full text HAL)

bibliography: Porcier, S.M., Berruyer, C., Pasquali, S., Ikram, S., Berthet, D., Tafforeau, P. 2019. Wild crocodiles hunted to make mummies in Roman Egypt: Evidence from synchrotron imaging. J. Archaeol. Sci. 110: 105009
